content.rendered:
Open an account

Easily open a new checking or savings account with Nebula Trust Bank. We offer several banking programs with free online and mobile banking, debit card, and money management tools.

Opening an account online just takes 10 minutes!

Easily open a new checking or savings account with Nebula Trust Bank. We offer several banking programs with free online and mobile banking, debit card, and money management tools.

Get Started

Already started? Check your email for a link to complete your application. Already a valued Nebula Trust customer? Sign in to online banking to complete the application process.

What you need to open an online bank account:

For all account owners:

  • Social Security number
  • Date of birth
  • Physical US address
  • Phone number
  • Email address
  • US issued driver’s license
  • Method of funding your new account

To verify your identity, Federal law requires us to obtain, verify, and record your name, address, date of birth, and other personal information.

Maybe you’re a people person?

Open a checking or savings account over the phone, through our Website, or in-person with someone passionate about helping you reach your goals. We have 14 locations and endless smiles. Find your Branch today.

Apply at a branch or through the ChelseaLIVE Website if:

  • You prefer to work with a knowledgeable team member
  • You want to open a business account
  • You want to start a Forte U Student Banking Program
  • You want to open a Certificate of Deposit or an Individual Retirement Account
  • You live outside of Global, Rhode Island, or Massachusetts

To learn more or to open an account by phone, call us at 678-465-8306.
